about.title: About FDN
about.metaDescription: FDN helps you decide what to eat in Hyderabad: dish-first rankings, living restaurant facts and honest community opinions.
about.intro: FDN is a food discovery network for Hyderabad. It answers one question fast: what should I eat, and where?
about.dishFirstBody: Restaurants are ranked by their dishes. Every restaurant page leads with what to order there, and every dish page ranks every place in the city that serves it.
about.factsBody: Opening hours, prices and phone numbers show when they were last confirmed. Anyone signed in can tap “Still true?” to keep them current.
about.honestBody: Ratings are weighted by trust, sponsored or hosted meals are labelled and never counted, and nothing paid can change a ranking, a dish score or a battle.
about.guestBody: You can browse, search, get directions and share without signing up. An account is only needed to rate, post, comment or vote.

guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.metaDescription: How FDN ratings work, what to disclose, what we remove and how to appeal.
guidelines.intro: FDN only works if people can trust what they read. These rules apply to every rating, post, comment, photo and fact.
guidelines.beHonestBody: Rate dishes you actually tried. Loved, Good, Okay and Skip describe the dish, not the restaurant’s staff or your mood that day.
guidelines.discloseBody: If the meal was free, paid for, or you work at or own the place, choose the matching disclosure. Disclosed posts stay visible with a tag, and their ratings are never counted in scores.
guidelines.scoresBody: Each rating is weighted by the member’s trust level and how recent it is. Scores are pulled toward the city average until enough ratings exist, and a score is shown only after at least three weighted ratings.
guidelines.removeItems: Spam and undisclosed promotion · Harassment, hate or threats · Sexual or violent content · Personal data such as private phone numbers or home addresses · Photos unrelated to food or restaurants · Fake or coordinated ratings
guidelines.enforcementBody: Moderators can remove content, lock threads, warn, suspend or ban. Three strikes in 90 days lead to an automatic 7-day suspension. Every action is recorded and the author is told why.
guidelines.appealBody: You can appeal each moderation action once. Appeals are reviewed by the FDN team, not by the moderator who acted.

notFound.title: We couldn’t find that page
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped.

offline.title: You’re offline
offline.body: Check your connection and try again. Pages you opened recently may still load.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Please try again. If it keeps happening, come back in a few minutes.

rating.scoreInfo: Scores weigh each rating by the member’s trust level and how recent it is, pulled toward the city average until there are enough ratings.
rating.foodScoreInfo: Food score is the weighted average of this restaurant’s top five dishes. It appears once at least two dishes have enough ratings.

landing.metaTitle: FDN · Know what to order before you go
landing.title: Know what to order before you go.
landing.subtitle: Find the best haleem, biryani or Irani chai near you, ranked dish by dish by people who actually ate it. Check if it’s open, how far it is, and what locals say, all in one place.

preview.label: Example of a dish card
preview.question: Where do I get haleem after midnight near Tolichowki?

problem.title: One dinner decision shouldn’t take six apps.
problem.body: Today you watch a reel to discover a place, open a map for distance and timings, a delivery app for prices, and a group chat for an honest opinion. FDN puts the answer in one page.

find.title: Find a dish
find.body: Search “haleem” or tap Open now, Under ₹300 or Late night. Dishes come first, ranked across the whole city.

facts.title: Check the facts
facts.body: Distance, open status, price and timings, each showing when it was last confirmed.

opinions.title: Read trusted opinions
opinions.body: See what to order at every restaurant and what locals say about it.

rate.title: Go, then rate it
rate.body: Get directions in one tap. Rate what you ate in under 20 seconds so the next person chooses better.

features.title: Built for the decision, not the scroll

whatToOrder.title: What to order here
whatToOrder.body: Every restaurant page opens with its best dishes, ranked by community sentiment.

cityRanking.title: The best version across the city
cityRanking.body: “Haleem in Hyderabad” ranks every place that serves it, filterable by area, price and open now.

battles.title: Dish Battles
battles.body: Two versions of the same dish go head to head. The community votes, the result is shareable.

livingFacts.title: Living facts
livingFacts.body: Prices and timings show their age. One tap on “Still true?” keeps them current.

askLocals.title: Ask the locals
askLocals.body: Questions go to people in that neighbourhood. The best answer gets pinned.

whatsapp.title: Made for WhatsApp
whatsapp.body: Every dish, list and battle has a clean preview card, so sharing a plan takes one tap.

ratings.title: Four honest words instead of 4.2 stars
ratings.body: Rate each dish Loved, Good, Okay or Skip. It’s faster, it’s clearer, and it tells the next person exactly what to order.
ratings.dietBody: Veg, egg and non-veg use shape as well as colour, so they’re readable for everyone.

noPayToRank.title: No pay-to-rank, ever
noPayToRank.body: Nothing paid can change a ranking, a dish score, a battle or a leaderboard.

disclosure.title: Disclosure built in
disclosure.body: Free meals, paid partnerships and staff posts are tagged and never counted in scores.

weighted.title: Weighted by trust
weighted.body: New accounts count less, fake-rating patterns are caught, and every score explains how it was calculated.

community.title: Food communities for every corner of the city
community.body: Join Hyderabad Food, your locality, or topics like Biryani, Haleem & Ramzan, Cafes, Street Food and Budget Eats.

final.title: Hungry? Start with what’s good near you.
final.body: Browse everything as a guest. Sign up only when you want to rate, post or save across devices.
